messages:
morgan: quick heads-up — i merged the docs PR for streaming snippets but spotted a bug in the Go pagination example, can someone take a look?
alex: pinged — what's the issue?
morgan: the loop uses Next() and assumes non-nil items. if the stream ends it can return io.EOF and we weren't handling it, leads to panic in sample harness.
jasmin: can you paste the minimal fix here? i can push a tiny patch to the PR.
morgan: sure — replace with:```go
for {
    item, err := cursor.Next()
    if err == io.EOF {
        break
    }
    if err != nil {
        return err
    }
    // handle item
}
```
jasmin: LGTM. also noticed the TS async iterator example doesn't await the error branch properly — i'll open a follow-up PR to avoid unhandled rejections.
rahul: i'll add a unit test for the go snippet harness so we catch regressions. assigning to myself; ETA EOD.
alex: one more thing — our retry example uses fixed sleep; we should show jittered exponential to avoid thundering herd. small snippet suggestion?
morgan: added this in the thread for the migration notes:```py
import random, time
for attempt in range(max_retries):
    backoff = base * (2 ** attempt)
    jitter = random.uniform(0.75, 1.25)
    time.sleep(backoff * jitter)
    # retry logic here
```
jasmin: good call. note in docs that the built-in SDK retry hooks exist and this snippet is for custom implementations only.
alex: tiny doc nit: the node streaming link in that section points to /sdk/node/embedding by accident — should link to /sdk/node/streaming.
morgan: fixed the link in the PR and pushed.
daniel-bot: deploy-preview updated: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.internal/412 — preview URL updated :white_check_mark:
rahul: pushed tests and a tiny guard for nil cursor. local run is green, will push to the branch now.
daniel-bot: CI passed on branch staging/docs-stream-fixes — all checks green :tada:
alex: great work — once CI artifacts finish, feel free to squash and merge. thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
jasmin: will merge after CI artifacts are available and then backport to the 1.3.x docs patch.
morgan: thanks all — leaving a TODO to add a short paragraph in migration-guide about resume-token TTLs (user question earlier). i'll draft that tomorrow.
rahul: on it too, will add a test case for empty-stream behavior.
alex: ship it after CI — nice speedy fix!
